changes.original_text: Each city from cit1 to cit9 has a position and an airport location (apt1 to apt9) with corresponding vehicles and packages.
changes.revised_text: For each integer X from 1 through 9, citX is a city, posX and aptX are locations in citX, aptX is an airport, truX is a truck, and objX1, objX2, and objX3 are packages; initially, truX and those three packages are at posX.
changes.reason_en: The original correspondence was undefined; the bounded X=1..9 rule uniquely supplies every required object, type, initial position, and city membership.
changes.reason_zh: 原对应关系未定义；有限的 X=1..9 规则唯一给出每个必需对象、类型、初始位置和城市隶属关系。
